title: PG&E Enters Bankruptcy Setting Stage for Major Restructuring
主要内容: PG&E Corp. filed for Chapter 11 protection early Tuesday morning, marking the largest utility bankruptcy in U.S. history. The filing follows a series of wildfires that left more than 100 people dead and destroyed an entire Northern California town. PG&E listed $51.7 billion in total debts, with an estimated $30 billion in potential wildfire liabilities. Despite last-minute rescue packages proposed by Elliott Management Corp. and Apollo Global Management LLC, and California’s assurances to address fire-liability policies, the state’s largest utility owner declared bankruptcy.
